title: fix(news): draw each character at most once per picture
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: News image requests now specify that Polli, the monitor robot and Nomnom are each unique individuals who may appear at most once per picture, including per-PR Discord images. The character reference sheet now shows one of each, using its bottom row scaled 3× with nearest-neighbour rendering; the brand guide repeats the rule, and the bee description names Polli without describing her as a separate character. In a non-posting practice run of nine daily and Sunday images, duplicate characters appeared in 0 of 9 images with this change, compared with 3 of 9 using the previous recipe.

image.prompt: Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. Wearing a tiny editor’s visor, she checks a single picture frame containing one Polli, one chunky CRT monitor robot and one round tan Nomnom beside a code-plant; keep Polli small-to-medium in the scene, show no duplicate characters, and use cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, a warm cream background and prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow.
